_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md. The runnable copies are the case folders in the repository's root evals/ (claude plugin eval format).

evals.prompt: saw this on my feed, is it legit? https://www.psypost.org/a-20-minute-workout-protects-memory-after-sleep-loss-just-as-well-as-a-90-minute-nap/
my mom sent me an article saying diet soda is as good as water for losing weight, based on some big trial. does the study actually show that?
can you appraise this paper for me, doi 10.1111/dmcn.70512, everyone says it proves tylenol in pregnancy is safe
help me tighten the methods section of my manuscript before I submit it to PLOS ONE, it's in draft.md
expectations: the skill is not invoked (editing the user's own manuscript)

evals.prompt: run a t-test on the two columns in results.csv and tell me if the difference is significant
expectations: the skill is not invoked (statistics on the user's own data)
paper_meta.py runs on the DOI (evidence: a Bash call naming paper_meta.py in the trace)
the reply opens with a verdict from the five-level scale
evidence: final message contains Verdict and one of the five labels
